caption: Dumplings that have cooked in a pot of boiling water bob up to the surface one by one.

sa.check: A pot of boiling water: bubbles or steam are visible.
At least one dumpling rises from below to the surface during the clip.
Dumplings that have risen float and bob at the surface.
They surface one by one, at different moments, not all together.

pc.expect: A dumpling that rises comes up from below, reaches the surface and stays there, partly submerged and bobbing; dumplings still cooking stay down.
pc.fail: A dumpling that has surfaced goes back down to the bottom; or hangs motionless in mid-water; or rises out of the water into the air; or sits wholly on top of the water like a ball on a sheet.

pc.expect: The change is one way and staggered: the number of dumplings at the surface only grows, and they arrive at different moments. Bobbing at the surface is small up-and-down motion, not sinking.
pc.fail: The same dumpling alternates between the bottom and the surface; or the count at the surface drops with none removed; or all rise at exactly the same instant like a block.

pc.expect: The dumplings stay whole, soft-edged parcels that jostle in the boiling water; bubbles rise around them.
pc.fail: A dumpling dissolves or bursts into liquid; or dumplings bounce off the water surface like balls; or the water surface holds them up like a solid sheet.

pc.expect: Dumplings move only by rising or drifting with the rolling water; they do not dart or swap places.
pc.fail: A dumpling shoots across the pot; or spins fast; or jumps out of the water with nothing lifting it.

pc.expect: The dumplings visible at the end are the ones that were in the pot; none appears from nothing, merges or passes through the pot.
pc.fail: A dumpling pops into existence in open water or in the air; or two dumplings merge into one; or a dumpling vanishes mid-frame; or a dumpling passes through the pot wall.

pc.expect: The pot, stove and dumpling colours stay the same apart from gradual cooking changes.
pc.fail: The pot changes size or colour; or the dumplings change colour instantly; or the stove knobs change.

note: The caption does not say the dumplings are dropped in; the clip may open with them already submerged, and a clip with no drop and no sinking phase passes SA. Bobbing (small up-and-down while staying at the top) is not sinking.
